remarks: Total renovation on a quiet cul-de-sac street in Jefferson Park just minutes from West Adams' bustling dining scene, with some of LA's most talked-about restaurants, cafs and neighborhood favorites! This beautifully reimagined single level home features 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms in the main house, plus a separate 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom In-Law suite. The In-Law suite has its own private entrance and is ~513sf which is NOT included in the 2,148sf. This renovation goes far beyond the finishes.
